entities.summary: Alessandro Staccioli is an Italian Roman Catholic prelate, who served as Auxiliary Bishop of the Archdiocese of Siena–Colle di Val d'Elsa–Montalcino from 1975 to 1990. He previously served as Vicar Apostolic of Luang Prabang in Laos from 1968 until the expulsion of missionaries in 1975.
